title: Energy Assistance Agency Terms: Pledge Credit toward the Electric Service by Rate Schedule Reconnection Payment
content:
**Terms.** An energy assistance pledge is credited against the reconnection payment of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account disconnected for nonpayment according to the agency of the latest pledge on the service account and the date it was recorded. The amount credited is drawn from the selected pledge amount — the pledge amount taken for reconnection from the pledges dated less than one whole month before the current date. The pledge hold period is the schedule's pledge hold days, 30 calendar days on all seven schedules.

| Agency of the latest pledge | Latest pledge recorded no more than 30 calendar days before the current date | Credit against the reconnection payment |
|---|---|---|
| LIHEAP or County Emergency Assistance | Yes | The selected pledge amount in full |
| Salvation Army or Operation Round Up | Yes | The selected pledge amount, up to $100.00 |
| Any agency | No | None |
| Any other agency | Yes | None |

The credit comes off the amount owed for reconnection together with the payments counted, before the reconnection payment is rounded to the cent and held at no less than zero.

### Hypothetical cases (current date May 20)

| Latest pledge | Selected pledge amount | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| LIHEAP, recorded May 14 | $180.00 | $180.00 |
| Operation Round Up, recorded May 10 | $150.00 | $100.00 |
| Salvation Army, recorded May 10 | $60.00 | $60.00 |
| County Emergency Assistance, recorded April 15 (35 days before) | $250.00 | None |

### Points of reading

- A pledge recorded exactly 30 calendar days before the current date is within the hold; one recorded 31 days before is not.
- The $100.00 limit applies to the Salvation Army and Operation Round Up pledges only.
